name: Portal da Transparencia (bulk downloads and web search)
tier_rationale: Government body (CGU, A8): 'trusted - Portal da Transparencia (CGU), Receita Federal, Sintegra/CCC, consumidor.gov.br, REDESIM/juntas comerciais, Jusbrasil, Reclame Aqui' (P250 cond 5); P240 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official federal sanctions registers (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, leniency agreements) published by CGU; a stale copy reads 'not screened', never 'not sanctioned' (P240 cond 8).

bulk_sanctions.title: CGU bulk downloads /download-de-dados/{ceis|cnep|cepim|acordos-leniencia}/{YYYYMMDD} (daily zip files)

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

bulk_sanctions.notes: Quote: binding A1 definition of 'open' (open government data); research C0548 terms 'Open government data (CGU)' / 'CGU open data.' Daily zips /download-de-dados/{ceis|cnep|cepim|acordos-leniencia}/{YYYYMMDD} (PEP monthly) through the dataset manager only, walking back at most 7 days on 404, never during a scan (P240 cond 1). Downloads answer 302 -> dadosabertos-download.cgu.gov.br, a single-batch host of P240 (batch p1-G10-2): add it with a transparencia__<batch>.json extension, never as a second CGU provider. Person rows keep only the name and the CPF exactly as published (masked), never a lookup key (P240 cond 6). The portal's web pages answer a CAPTCHA to scripts, so the evidence page was not re-fetched on 2026-11-26. Used by cgu_sanctions_bulk.

web_search.title: Portal da Transparencia web search /busca?termo= (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

web_search.notes: Research C0584 terms 'public open data / free public API'. Manual link portaldatransparencia.gov.br/busca?termo= with the formatted CNPJ ({cnpj_fmt}) or the company name; never a CPF or person name (P250 cond 8, cond 9); the /pessoa-juridica/{cnpj} page (bot challenge) is not used. Used by pivots_brazil.

notes: Split from transparencia_api: the keyed API has its own key and per-key budget. Seeded once for batches p1-G10-2 and p2-G14-2 (P240, P250). ttl 86400 = sanctions class (P326 cond 7). .br hosts default to Accept-Language pt-BR.
